title: abap2UI5 for Excel
tagline: Show an app in Excel's task pane and read and write the workbook.
summary: An Office add-in that opens an abap2UI5 app in the task pane of Microsoft Excel: the real abap2UI5 UI5 frontend, served by your SAP system through a host page in the BSP Z2UI5_XL. The app stays an ABAP class and talks to the workbook through the custom control z2ui5.cc.ExcelBridge, which writes tables into sheets and reads selected cells. The repository holds the host page, a demo app, the manifest generator and the tests. It is a proof of concept: CI tests it against a stand-in for Office.js, nobody has run it in a real Excel yet.
features: Any abap2UI5 app runs in Excel's task pane, started by the manifest's --app option
z2ui5.cc.ExcelBridge writes an ABAP table to a cell, the selection or a new sheet
Reads the selected cells into an ABAP table, with an optional selection-change event
Values keep their types: text, numbers and ISO dates, leading zeros preserved
npm run manifest writes the add-in manifest for your host, client, app and theme
Deployment via the Microsoft 365 admin center or sideloading on Windows, Mac and web
Serve the host page from an approuter or reverse proxy where there is no BSP
requirements: abap2UI5 with z2ui5.cc.ExcelBridge (pull request #2847, on main since commit bcce7d6; the first release after 1.146.0 that lists it)
The embed control needs abap2UI5 1.145.0 or later
UI5 1.71 or later on the system; theme sap_horizon needs UI5 1.102+, else --theme sap_fiori_3
HTTPS with a certificate the users' machines trust
Excel: Microsoft 365, Excel 2019 or later on Windows or Mac, Excel on the web best effort (ExcelApi 1.4)
ABAP Cloud: no BSP applications, pull only src/01 and serve the host page without a BSP

notes: Pull with abapGit into a package of its own (for example $Z2UI5_XL) on the system that runs abap2UI5; it brings Z2UI5_CL_XL_DEMO, the BSP Z2UI5_XL and the ICF nodes /sap/bc/ui5_ui5/sap/z2ui5_xl and /sap/bc/bsp/sap/z2ui5_xl
In SICF check that /sap/bc/ui5_ui5/sap/z2ui5_xl is active with the same logon settings as /sap/bc/z2ui5
Try it in a browser first: https://<sap-host>/sap/bc/ui5_ui5/sap/z2ui5_xl/index.html?app=Z2UI5_CL_XL_DEMO
Write the manifest with npm run manifest -- --host https://my.sap.example --app Z2UI5_CL_XL_DEMO --client 100 --out manifest.xml and deploy it to users
For Excel on the web set the frame-ancestors and SameSite cookie headers on the system
